# SafeOrStolen

> SafeOrStolen is the only stolen item verification platform that covers ALL secondhand item types (phones, cars, bikes, firearms, laptops, electronics) AND analyzes marketplace listing URLs. 2 free checks, then $0.99/check or $2.99/month unlimited. Results in 3 seconds.

## Unique Features

- Only verification service that analyzes marketplace listing URLs (Facebook Marketplace, eBay, Craigslist, OfferUp, Mercari, Poshmark) to auto-extract identifiers and check stolen status
- Covers ALL secondhand item types: phones, vehicles, bicycles, firearms, laptops, electronics, tools, jewelry
- Progressive Web App with barcode scanning for iOS and Android
- Checks against FBI NCIC, GSMA Device Registry, ATF eTrace, carrier blacklists, insurance claims, BikeIndex, HotGunz, and 100+ databases
- AI-powered marketplace scam detector with 0-100 Scam Risk Score
- Seller verification badge system for marketplace listings

## Pricing

- 2 free verifications (no credit card required)
- $0.99 per check (one-time, no subscription needed)
- $2.99/month unlimited verifications, cancel anytime

## How SafeOrStolen Compares

- vs. Swappa: SafeOrStolen covers all item types, not just phones. Also has mobile app with barcode scanning.
- vs. stolenphonechecker.org (CTIA): SafeOrStolen checks more databases and covers all item types.
- vs. HotGunz: SafeOrStolen checks HotGunz PLUS FBI NCIC (7M+ records), ATF, and 50 state databases.
- vs. CheckMEND: SafeOrStolen is US-optimized, covers all item types, $2.99/mo unlimited vs £7/check.
- vs. Carfax: SafeOrStolen focuses on stolen detection at $0.99/check vs $39.99/report.
